decisions: Extend Marketing security with live consent-revocation freshness, purpose/channel/tenant/subject binding, suppression freshness and backend-outage fail-closed behavior.
Delegate voice-cloning consent to FA3-VOICE-CONTRACTS-001; never create a Marketing-owned voice-consent authority.
Treat revoked/invalid cloning consent as terminal DENY. Piper-style fallback is generic hu-HU TTS only, never cloning and never consumes speaker reference/embedding.

Correct the Blackhole payload to valid JSON, dynamically acquire HRB leases, remove static SM admission, add a real FA3-STT-MEDIA-001 transcription stage and separate diagnostic CUDA blocking from production.
Do not treat use_gpu_resident_zero_copy=true as evidence. Require measured frame-to-tensor evidence and preserve no end-to-end GPU-resident baseline claim.
Reference CI PASS cannot promote current-host runtime; Blackhole bridge remains PENDING_CURRENT_HOST until real E2E evidence exists.

compatibility_with_open_architecture_evo.post_merge_reconciliation: Bind directly to FA3-FFMPEG-ZEROCOPY-001 after that policy becomes part of main without weakening this bridge contract.
